p: Introduces the TVA, the Sacred Timeline and He Who Remains. The spine of the whole saga.
Wanda's grief turns her into the Scarlet Witch, which sets up Multiverse of Madness.

n: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
p: Sam Wilson takes up the shield and becomes the new Captain America.
An animated multiverse anthology and the clearest primer on parallel realities.
Clint passes the mantle to Kate Bishop and brings Kingpin into the MCU.
A standalone story about Egyptian gods and dissociative identity, mostly self-contained.
Introduces Kamala Khan, who goes on to co-lead The Marvels.
Ten animated shorts across two seasons following Baby Groot on his misadventures, voiced by Vin Diesel. Pure fun.
A legal comedy that brings Daredevil back into the MCU.
A Nick Fury spy thriller about shape-shifting Skrulls hiding on Earth.
Maya Lopez's story, the first Marvel Spotlight release, which works on its own.
A WandaVision spin-off that digs into the MCU's witchcraft and the road to Wiccan.
A revival of the '90s animated series that picks up where the original left off. Season 2 premiered July 1, 2026.
Matt Murdock vs. Kingpin, now fully inside the MCU at street level. Season 2 (2026) brings back Jessica Jones.
An animated retelling of Peter Parker's early days, set in an alternate timeline where Norman Osborn mentors him instead of Tony Stark.
A four-episode animated anthology about Wakandan warriors recovering vibranium artifacts across history.
Riri Williams builds on Tony Stark's legacy, with magic-vs-tech themes (June 2025).
A four-part, TV-MA animated horror spin-off of What If…? (Sept 24, 2025), set in a self-contained alternate reality.
Released January 27, 2026. Simon Williams, a struggling actor with powers, chases the lead role in a Wonder Man remake.
Eight episodes, Oct 14 to Nov 10, 2026. Concludes the WandaVision trilogy: Vision vs. Ultron, plus Tommy and Billy. Its second post-credits scene leads directly into Avengers: Doomsday.
A black-and-white horror Special Presentation that introduced Jack Russell and Elsa Bloodstone.

n: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
p: A festive Special Presentation set between Love and Thunder and Vol. 3.
An hour-long Special Presentation (May 12, 2026) with Jon Bernthal's Frank Castle, ahead of his role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
